sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS The Fund will invest the proceeds of the offering of Shares in accordance with its investment objectives and strategies as stated below. The Advisor generally expects that, under normal circumstances, the Fund will be able to fully invest the net proceeds according to its investment objectives and strategies within approximately three months after receipt of the proceeds. However, in certain limited circumstances, such as in the case of unusually large cash inflows, the Fund may take up to six months to fully invest the net proceeds. A delay in the anticipated use of proceeds could lower returns and reduce the Fund’s distribution to shareholders.
